bagPolicy.summary: Bags must be clear and no larger than 12" x 12" x 6". Small clutches up to 6" x 9" are allowed.
allowed: Clear, plastic, or PVC tote bag no larger than 12" x 12" x 6"
prohibited: Any bag larger than 12" x 12" x 6"
Alcohol or beverages other than a sealed bottle of water
Over-the-counter medication not in original packaging
Professional photo, video, or audio recording equipment
Weapons, sharp objects or weapon accessories

parking.note: General admission parking is included with your ticket. For a shorter walk, easier exit, or oversized parking, consider upgrading to Premier Parking options.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Shoreline Amphitheatre's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Shoreline Amphitheatre offers a variety of food and drink options, including Mosh Burger's hormone-free beef burgers, Rebel Hen's crispy chicken tenders, and Ziggy's Magic Pizza Shop's NY-inspired pizzas. Koko's Bavarian provides German-inspired sausages and pretzels, while general concessions offer popcorn, nachos, and a selection of beverages. CVT Premium Soft Serve Ice Cream is also available in convenient pouches.
stands: CVT Premium Soft Serve Ice Cream

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The Accessibility Shuttle pick-up and drop-off zone is located in the northwest corner of Lot A, near the Shoreline Blvd & Bill Graham Pkwy/North Road intersection. Limited storage is available for wheelchairs, canes, walkers, and other mobility devices.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Shoreline Amphitheatre's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will call tickets are available for pickup at the box office, between both main entry gates. On show days, Box Office opens at 12pm.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Shoreline Amphitheatre. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
